nodes.description: Per-address sale counter mapping in UniswapExchange, incremented on every transferFrom and read in condition().
Whitelist mapping granting accounts a bypass of condition() inside ensure().
Minimum sale amount threshold, set in init() from the token parameter.
Maximum sale amount threshold, set in init() from the maxToken parameter.
Maximum number of sales per sender allowed, set in init().
Configurable address whitelisted inside ensure(); writable by owner via setTradeAddress().
Public balance ledger mapping; mutated with unchecked += and -= arithmetic in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested allowance mapping; decremented with unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
Private privileged address set in the constructor from msg.sender and used as the only access-control gate.
Hard-coded Uniswap router constant address also whitelisted in ensure().
Constant token decimals (18) used as an exponent in scaling arithmetic.
Public total supply, computed in the constructor as _supply*(10**decimals).
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable core transfer routine: allowance decrement and balance updates are done without SafeMath and can be abused.
Public payable approval writer for allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal whitelist gate allowing owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses to bypass condition().
Internal sale-limit predicate reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and bytes payload.
Privileged mint that sets balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) with no overflow check and whitelists the spender.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only loop distributing tokens; computes total = _value * _tos.length and subtracts it unchecked.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation via keccak256 and init code hash.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and initial balances/allowances.
Private SafeERC20 helper performing a low-level address(token).call(data).
Caller-controlled address driving every access-control check and transfer path.
Arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address executed in this contract's storage context.
Low-level call to an arbitrary token address inside callOptionalReturn.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom (arithmetic).
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend (arithmetic).
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend (arithmetic).

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument of transferFrom via transfer().
msg.sender is compared to _from and used as the spender key for allowance[_from][msg.sender].
msg.sender is the allowance owner written by approve().
require(msg.sender == owner) is the sole gate before the arbitrary delegatecall.
_mints is gated by msg.sender == owner or a hard-coded privileged address.
init() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing all later privilege.
transfer() returns the result of transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) before moving balances.
ensure() falls through to condition(_from, _value) when the sender is not whitelisted.
delegate() executes the attacker-supplied delegatecall payload.
callOptionalReturn performs address(token).call(data).
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow checks.
batchSend executes balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked.
The batchSend loop is driven by the local index i.
Each loop iteration binds the local recipient _to from _tos[i].
Arbitrary delegatecall code runs in this contract's context and can re-enter transferFrom against shared balance state.
The external token low-level call can re-enter transferFrom before accounting is finalised.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value writes to the balance mapping.
The unchecked total computed in batchSend determines balance disribution.
Unchecked subtraction of total from the sender balance mapping.
_mints writes balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) with unchecked multiplication.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting a condition() bypass.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every successful transfer.
transferFrom mutates the balanceOf mapping entry of both sender and recipient.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to whitelist an unrestricted account.
ensure() reads the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
ensure() compares _from/_to against owner for a full bypass.
ensure() compares _from against the hard-coded UNI constant.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales per address.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer amount.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the sale cap.
init() sets _minSale = token*(10**decimals) using unchecked scaling arithmetic.
init() sets _maxSale = maxToken*(10**decimals) using unchecked scaling arithmetic.
init() assigns the sale count cap _saleNum.
setTradeAddress writes the owner-controlled tradeAddress whitelist entry.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the total supply.
The constructor writes an infinite allowance for the Uniswap router.
The constructor computes totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals) with unchecked multiplication.
The constructor uses the decimals constant as an exponent.
pairFor derives the pair address that ensure() compares against tradeAddress/whitelists.
